heading.en: Is a potato a root or a stem?

hook.en: Potatoes grow underground, so most people think they are roots. But look closely at the "eyes" on a potato and you will find buds. Only stems carry buds.
hook.kn: ಆಲೂಗಡ್ಡೆ ನೆಲದೊಳಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಅದನ್ನು ಬೇರು ಎಂದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅದರ "ಕಣ್ಣು"ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊಗ್ಗುಗಳಿವೆ. ಮೊಗ್ಗು ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

objectives.en: State the features and functions of the stem
Describe underground and aerial stem modifications
Distinguish runner, stolon, offset and sucker

narration.en: Potatoes grow underground, so most people think they are roots. But look closely at the "eyes" on a potato and you will find buds. Only stems carry buds.
narration.kn: ಆಲೂಗಡ್ಡೆ ನೆಲದೊಳಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಅದನ್ನು ಬೇರು ಎಂದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅದರ "ಕಣ್ಣು"ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊಗ್ಗುಗಳಿವೆ. ಮೊಗ್ಗು ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

body.en: The stem develops from the plumule of the embryo. It bears nodes, where leaves arise, and internodes between them. It carries terminal and axillary buds. The stem spreads out branches with leaves, flowers and fruits, and conducts water, minerals and food. Some stems store food, support the plant, protect it, or help in perennation and vegetative propagation.
body.kn: ಕಾಂಡ ಭ್ರೂಣದ ಪ್ರಾಂಕುರದಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಣ್ಣುಗಳು, ಗೆಣ್ಣಂತರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮೊಗ್ಗುಗಳಿವೆ. ಕಾಂಡ ನೀರು, ಖನಿಜ ಮತ್ತು ಆಹಾರವನ್ನು ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: The stem grows from the plumule. Leaves arise at nodes; the gaps between are internodes.
A terminal bud at the tip, and an axillary bud in the angle of each leaf.
Underground stems store food: tuber, rhizome and corm.
In deserts, green stems do the photosynthesis.
Some stems spread the plant: stolons, offsets and suckers.

body.en: Underground stems store food: potato (tuber), ginger and turmeric (rhizome), and Colocasia and zaminkand (corm). Stem tendrils from axillary buds help gourds and grapevines climb, while thorns from axillary buds protect Citrus and Bougainvillea. In arid regions Opuntia has a flattened green stem and Euphorbia a fleshy cylindrical one that carry out photosynthesis.
body.kn: ಭೂಗತ ಕಾಂಡಗಳು ಆಹಾರ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತವೆ: ಆಲೂಗಡ್ಡೆ, ಶುಂಠಿ, ಅರಿಶಿನ, ಸುವರ್ಣಗಡ್ಡೆ. ಕುಂಬಳ, ದ್ರಾಕ್ಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಂಡ ಸುರುಳಿತಂತು; ನಿಂಬೆ, ಬೊಗನ್‌ವಿಲ್ಲಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳ್ಳು. ಪಾಪಾಸುಕಳ್ಳಿಯ ಕಾಂಡ ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಸಿರು.

points.en: Tendrils (gourds, grapevine) and thorns (Citrus, Bougainvillea) from axillary buds

body.en: In mint and jasmine, a slender lateral branch grows in the air for a while and then arches down to touch the ground: a stolon. Pistia and Eichhornia have offsets, lateral branches with short internodes, each node bearing a rosette of leaves and a tuft of roots. In banana, pineapple and Chrysanthemum, suckers grow from the underground base of the main stem and come up as new leafy shoots. Underground stems of grass and strawberry also spread to new places.
body.kn: ಪುದೀನ, ಮಲ್ಲಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಟೋಲನ್; ಪಿಸ್ಟಿಯಾ, ಐಕಾರ್ನಿಯಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಫ್‌ಸೆಟ್; ಬಾಳೆ, ಅನಾನಸ್, ಸೇವಂತಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕ್ಕರ್‌ಗಳು ಹೊಸ ಸಸ್ಯ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: Give two pieces of evidence that the potato is a stem and not a root.

steps.en: The "eyes" of a potato are nodes bearing buds; roots do not have nodes and buds.
When a potato is kept in the light it turns green and the eyes sprout into leafy shoots, as stems do.
So the potato is an underground stem modified for storage: a stem tuber.

answer.en: It has nodes with buds (eyes) that grow into shoots; it is a stem tuber

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Give two pieces of evidence that the potato is a stem and not a root.

body.en: If it has nodes, internodes or buds, it is a stem, however root-like it looks: potato, ginger, turmeric and Colocasia.
